sources_tried: Seed file research/installers/raw/seeds/indianapolis.json: worked. Of the 45 Maps results, about 6 were plausible; most were residential bath remodelers, plumbers, HVAC and glass shops. The 17 web results were Google redirect links pointing to directories and remodelers.

Seed websites checked: allsourcespecialties.com, midwest-specialties.com, indianawholesalesupply.com, cih-inc.com and laforceinc.com worked. Excluded after checking: lyoninc.com (glass block only), locations.irvmat.com Specialties Company (ground stabilization, not Division 10), division10solutions.com (redirects to d10pro.com, based in Rochester IN, about 95 miles away; it does list restroom partitions).
Bobrick find-a-rep (bobrick.com/find-a-rep): page loaded but the rep dropdown didn't come through; no Indiana rep found.
Scranton Products where-to-buy: worked, but it lists only a regional sales rep (a person, so not added), no Indianapolis dealers.
ASI, Bradley, Metpar, General Partitions and Ampco locators: not tried (search and fetch budget).
The Blue Book (thebluebook.com): 403, blocked on search page and iProView profiles.
BuildingConnected / Procore public profiles: not tried.
BBB category pages (Indianapolis Partitions, Fishers Partitions, Franklin Lockers): worked. These gave Space Management Installations, AllSource and RS Locker Repair.
Florence Mailboxes dealer page for AllSource: worked.

WebSearch (8 of 8 used): 'toilet partition installation Indianapolis', 'Division 10 specialties contractor Indianapolis toilet compartments', 'restroom partitions installer Indiana Carmel Fishers Noblesville', 'AllSource Construction Specialties Indianapolis Division 10', 'Aptura Group Indianapolis Division 10...', 'Space Management Installations Indianapolis partitions', 'commercial toilet partitions lockers installer ... yelp' (no Yelp results), and the furnish-and-install query. Leads not added: Aptura Group (only job ads for a Division 10 installer in Indianapolis; the job page returned 410 and the company site wasn't found), Indiana Door & Hardware Specialties (Bloomington, outside 30 miles), One Point Partitions (online seller with a Greenwood delivery terminal; a search snippet says it doesn't install; its site returned 403), Innovate Commercial Interiors (named in a search summary with AllSource's phone number, not checked).
onepointpartitions.com: 403. Google search fetch: blocked (error page). indychamber.com: 404.

candidates.name: Indiana Wholesale Supply Co
candidates.partition_evidence: Bathroom Partitions page says it supplies and installs partitions, with layout design and professional installation. It lists projects: Shindig Restaurant in Indianapolis (Metpar, 6 stalls), Harding-Poorman office building in Indianapolis (Metpar, 5 stalls, removed the old partitions) and Kingsway Christian Church in Avon (FlushMetal stainless, 10 stalls).
candidates.reason: Commercial Division 8/10 supplier in Indianapolis with named local partition installation projects. It sells partitions itself, so the buy-around risk is high.

license.name: Indiana Wholesale Supply Co
license.registry: City of Indianapolis/Marion County Department of Business and Neighborhood Services (BNS) licensed/listed contractor records, Accela Citizen Access portal (aca-prod.accela.com/INDY)
license.note: Indiana has no state license for this work; Indianapolis requires contractors to be listed with BNS. The BNS licensee search runs only in the Accela portal as an ASP.NET postback form. Automated requests were rejected ('Potential cross-site request forgery attacks. The Referer and Origin headers are missing'), and a retry was blocked, so no record was read. Check by hand in the Accela portal (Search for Licensee) or ask BNS (contractors@indy.gov, a third-party listing gives this address; not verified on indy.gov). This business may be a distributor rather than an installer, so it may not need to be listed at all. Checked 2026-11-19.

candidates.name: Schricker-CIH (CIH / Central Indiana Hardware)
candidates.partition_evidence: Its toilet partitions page says it ships and installs partitions anywhere in the USA, offers installation for every product it sells and includes layout drawings with every partition shipment.
candidates.reason: Long-running commercial Division 8/10/28 company with an Indianapolis office. It states it installs toilet partitions. As a large distributor it also sells partitions, so the buy-around risk is high.
red_flags: Multi-state distributor with 5 locations, not a dedicated installer
